name: ConvNeXt
plain: Meta's ConvNeXt (Liu et al. 2022; tiny, small, base, large; ImageNet-1k, and ImageNet-22k fine-tuned at 224 and 384): a convolutional classifier of 7x7 depthwise convolutions, LayerNorm and MLP blocks. Apache-2.0.
summary: ConvNeXt (Liu et al. 2022): a pure convolutional network of 7x7 depthwise conv + LayerNorm + MLP blocks, Meta's ImageNet-1k and ImageNet-22k checkpoints.

official.reason: timm ships a maintained re-implementation with the same Meta ImageNet-1k/22k weights and a uniform API.

task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: ImageNet-1k class logits.
